ela: Heads-up I opened a short PR to extract timeout + 429 fallback examples into a dedicated troubleshooting page. PR #6892.

noah: Seen. Can we include tiny JS (AbortController) and Python async examples + a Go Retry-After snippet? Ops wants clear header parsing.

adele: I'll add the JS + Python. For wording, standardize on the phrase "context trim" (define first use).

ciara: I'll draft Go parsing example: parse Retry-After, fallback to exp jitter if missing. Also add note: only retry for idempotent requests.

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck passed; snippet-lint flagged missing language tag on one block.

ela: fixed markup and pushed. timeline: can we merge by tomorrow morning? Marketing needs a 1-line blurb.

noah: quick review done. two small edits: add telemetry query to measure token-trim rates and a test case ensuring trimmed prompt returns non-empty output.

adele: added both. docs-bot: snippet-lint passed.

ela: merging now. will follow up to add runbook redirect. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
